text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager - Elevated 5xx + 429s observed on api-prod (us-west-2). Spike started ~1775001000. Symptoms: large wave of 429s from gateway -> retries causing backend 5xxs. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Severity: SEV2. Link: https://internal.ops/incident/1775001234

oncall-jamie: I'm on it. Paging SRE. Setting comms channel here.

sre-lee: grabbing metrics now. tl;dr: global quota token store saw sudden drop in available tokens around 1775000987; rate-limiter started returning 429 to many customers, upstream services retried and overloaded model-serving -> 5xx.

infra-anya: I see a config rollout at 1774999800 from release/qs-2026-04 that changed quota mode to "global" (was "per-tenant"). Patch summary: 
```
quota.mode: global
shard_count: 4
cache_ttl: 30s
```
That would cause tenants to share buckets. Looks like unintended.

eng-runtime-devin: if quota is global, hot tenants can consume the single global bucket and cause others to get 429s; retries push load into serving runtime -> OOMs/5xx. Also noticed KV cache eviction rates spiked.

oncall-jamie: OK, plan: 1) Roll back quota.mode to per-tenant immediately. 2) Temporarily increase shard_count and token refill rate to avoid immediate drop. 3) Add temporary routing rule for big tenants to dedicated pool. Who can do the rollback?

infra-anya: I'll roll back the config in the config-service now (starting rollback). Running deploy: `deployctl promote release/qs-2026-03`

deploy-bot: rollback-job-3235 started by infra-anya at 1775001355. Rolling back config change in quota-service.

support-maria: quick customer impact check: Support queue shows ~27 incidents tagged with 429/timeout. Top impacted: BoxCo (high traffic), Edutech-UK, ShopFast. BoxCo reports 20% of requests failing for last 10m. Preparing customer comms draft.

sre-lee: while rollback is in flight, let's also open a temporary override: bump per-tenant token_limit for top 10 tenants to avoid immediate throttling. infra-anya can we patch token refill?

infra-anya: patching refill now: `kubectl exec -n infra config-service -- curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/patch -d '{"token_refill": {"rate": 2.5}}'` applying to staging -> prod via emergency path.

eng-runtime-devin: adding fallback routing for /v1/generate: low-latency fallback to lightweight model (model-lite) for requests that would be throttled. Pushing route rule: `route: if quota.remaining < 10 -> model-lite`

oncall-jamie: monitoring logs. Gateway 429 tailing down?

sre-lee: yes, 429 rate peaked at 1775001100 and is falling. 5xxs from serving are still elevated but decreasing. Graphs: 429s 80% -> 15% in last 7m. 5xxs: 30% -> 8% in last 6m.

deploy-bot: rollback-job-3235 completed at 1775001470. Status: SUCCESS.

infra-anya: rollback confirmed. quota.mode = per-tenant. Cache warmed, shard_count increased to 8 temporarily.

support-maria: sending interim customer notice to affected accounts (BoxCo + others) with root-cause summary and ETA for full postmortem. Draft: "We've identified a quota configuration regression that caused shared token depletion; we've rolled back and traffic is recovering. We'll follow up with full postmortem." Ping me for edits.

product-raj: any SLA breaches? Need numbers for biz comms.

sre-lee: preliminary: some clients saw increased error rates for ~18 minutes. We'll quantify requests failed and tokens lost, include in postmortem. For now, no data-exfil or auth issues.

eng-runtime-devin: one more note: retry logic in gateway amplified the problem. We should adjust retry backoff for 429 -> exponential with jitter immediate change. Filing task.

oncall-jamie: status update (1775001900): system metrics near baseline, 429s < 2% for most tenants, 5xxs < 1.5% and falling. Triage team to remain for 30m; handoff to SRE-lee for watch.

sre-lee: taking watch. Assigning follow-ups:
- ENG-Runtime: investigate retry/backoff changes (devin)
- Infra: add guard to prevent global quota-mode rollout without canary (anya)
- Support/Product: finalize customer communications (maria/raj)
- Ops: run query to list tenants impacted and compute SLA exposure (jamie)

support-maria: confirmed draft sent to BoxCo & Edutech-UK; notifying CS.

oncall-jamie: handing incident to sre-lee at 1775002100. Oncall clear.

sre-lee: monitoring; will open postmortem and link to this thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: incident-1775001234 marked RESOLVED at 1775002348 by sre-lee.

sre-lee: resolution summary for postmortem: root cause = misapplied quota config (global mode) deployed in config-service -> caused shared token buckets, hot-tenant consumption -> 429s + retry amplification -> model-serving 5xx. Mitigation = rollback to per-tenant, shard_count increase, temporary token refill bump, fallback routing to model-lite, and customer comms. Next steps: action items created in backlog, postmortem scheduled.

support-maria: noting impacted customers list and percent failures to attach to postmortem.

infra-anya: adding deploy rule: block future quota.mode changes without staged canary and automated smoke tests.

eng-runtime-devin: filing PR to update gateway retry policy and add circuit-breaker on downstream model-service to prevent cascade.

sre-lee: thanks team. Closing live channel in 1 hour after watch period.
